entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely useless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable!
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that return for you. Can I start with your name and order number?

The name is Sam Kinski. Order number is... 90-210-Alpha. And let me tell you, these things are a joke. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but all I've gotten are painful blisters. They're unwearable.
Thank you, Mr. Kinski. One moment while I pull up your order... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Gear cycling shoes, delivered 67 days ago. Is that correct?
67 days sounds right. 67 days of torture. Your policy says 90 days, and I want a full refund. Don't try to give me the runaround or I'll be speaking to your manager and posting reviews everywhere.
I understand your frustration, sir. There's no need for that. Let me just confirm the policy for you... Yes, I can see right here that you are well within the 90-day return window.
See! I told you. So process it. I'm not waiting on hold all day.

Of course. I am approving this return for you right now. I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to the address on file. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive the item, we'll process your full refund to the original payment method.
Fine. Just make sure that refund shows up quickly. I've wasted enough time and money on this.
You have my word, Mr. Kinski. The refund will be processed as soon as the return is logged in our warehouse. Is there anything else I can help you with?
